scope: Windows CUDA consumer source/dependency closure refresh and final link, using the retained original native/vendor/toolchain closure; not all-platform or full-SDK certification.

build.default_backend_CRT_architecture_contrac: Original actual per-TU macro, precision, CRT and sm89 flags retained; source/header references use canonical current paths. No old five-header overlay.

final_link.limits: Build only. Semantic provenance of retained vendor/native inputs is separate; no model behavior, throughput, memory or other-platform claim.

groups.evidence: native-remaining-facts.json: per-object matching object SHA and source/dependency pins
native-dependency-filter.json; broad manifest changes are not in actual compiler .d

native-bridge-additive.diff; exact old9f payload recovered; only cstdint and new function declaration added. NativeFailure/fail and all original signatures identical. mmid has no bridge call; ssm only uses fail.

native-remaining-facts.json: exact original object+source records and recipes. These source-native pointer/scalar/vendor interfaces do not pass ResourceBudget, Graph internals or CacheStorage; no concrete current signature/layout change found.
groups.limitation: Not a full original compiler-header identity proof; retained frozen vendor/toolchain contract, not newly compiled current SDK.

groups.evidence: native-supplemental-pins.json: source groups, commands/exited records, native header boundary; original object pins remain in native-remaining-facts.json.
groups.limitation: Some historical groups pin source+successful output path rather than one joint object/source/compiler-dependency identity record; do not label every old object current-canonical compiled.

retained_native.boundaries: Native source-only/grouped provenance records are identified as such; they are not promoted to complete compiler-header history. Exact old/current bridge changes are additive only. Original pinned GGML patches, FlashInfer portability overrides, Torch/CUDA/oneDNN libraries remain retained rather than newly rebuilt.

first_failures.detail: Initial harness accepted /I but not existing equivalent -I include spelling; corrected path parsing, no compiler/source change.
norm_kernel suffix also matched sglang_norm_kernel; exact basename separator fixed. Zero compiler processes started before correction.

intermediate_behavior.scope: These two original two-turn ordinary/MTP behavior checks used the intermediate fa32 image before the final seven own CUDA leaves were replaced. They do not certify behavior or performance of final 2a94 image.

limits: Final 2a94 record here proves compilation/link and source/dependency/object mapping only. The subsequent full32 run and its results are outside this build archive.
No new CPU/Apple/Vulkan Model, other-model, task-quality, concurrency fault-injection, or all-platform test is claimed.
No throughput, memory, or speed improvement is inferred from compiler times, link success or the intermediate behavior pair.
Foreign libraries and frozen native patch/template revisions are reused with the documented boundaries; this is not a latest-upstream or whole-SDK rebuild claim.
Archive contains command/dependency/source-hash metadata, scripts and small logs; no OBJ/EXE/DLL/LIB/SDK/model bodies or duplicate full source tree.
